description: This file defines the RetrieveThingsResponseSignalMapper class, which maps retrieve things response signals within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It extends an abstract class and implements an interface, providing logic for validating response types and constructing topic paths and payloads.

classes.name: RetrieveThingsResponseSignalMapper
classes.description: A final class that maps retrieve things response signals, validating responses, building topic paths, and enhancing payloads.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the command response class name ends with 'Response', throwing an exception otherwise.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new TopicPathBuilder from the namespace, defaulting to a placeholder if absent.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Adds status and entity information to the payload builder based on the command response.
